description: This PHP source file defines the SystemCheckAPI class, which extends a parent class to provide an API endpoint for system checks during installation. It specifically overrides the handleGet method to add a check for directory write permissions if data encryption is enabled.

classes.name: SystemCheckAPI
classes.description: API controller class for performing system checks during installation, with special handling for encrypted data directory permissions.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to perform system checks, adding write permission check for cryptokeys directory if encryption is enabled.
